name: agent-conventions
description: Personal coding conventions, agent skills and documentation for React, TypeScript, CSS, Testing, Figma and Blueprint

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run sync:readme && npm run sync:favicon && for-humanity dev
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run check:generated && npm run check:diagrams && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:examples && npm run typecheck:examples && npm run test
scripts.content:build: npm run build && npm run sync:readme && npm run sync:favicon && for-humanity build && tsx script/finalize-content.ts
scripts.lint:examples: biome lint --config-path=skill/examples.biome.json skill && biome lint --config-path=skill/incorrect.biome.json skill && stylelint --config skill/stylelint.config.mjs "skill/*/examples/**/*-correct*.css" && stylelint --config skill/incorrect.stylelint.config.mjs "skill/*/examples/**/*-incorrect*.css"
